steps.command:
ls -la /workspace
echo "=== find .git dirs ==="
find /workspace -maxdepth 4 -name .git 2>/dev/null
echo "=== /app ==="
ls -la /app 2>/dev/null || echo "no /app"

cd /workspace/personal-site
git status
echo "=== BRANCHES ==="
git branch -a -vv
echo "=== RECENT HEAD REFLOG ==="
git reflog --date=iso -40
echo "=== STASHES ==="
git stash list
echo "=== ALL REFS ==="
git for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname:short) %(committerdate:iso)'

cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "=== LOST COMMIT ==="
git show --stat --oneline 650dba4
echo
echo "=== FULL LOG graph master + lost ==="
git log --oneline --graph --decorate --all 650dba4 -10
echo
echo "=== DIFF master..650dba4 ==="
git diff --stat master 650dba4
echo
echo "=== PATCH ==="
git diff master 650dba4
echo
echo "=== parents of lost commit ==="
git log -1 --format='%H %P %s' 650dba4
git log -1 --format='%H %P %s' master

cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "=== master change since base c4e38a1 ==="
git diff --stat c4e38a1 master
git diff c4e38a1 master
echo "=== merge-base ==="
git merge-base master 650dba4
echo "=== files differing between master and lost ==="
git diff --name-only master 650dba4
echo "=== remotes ==="
git remote -v

cd /workspace/personal-site
set -e
git merge --no-ff 650dba4 -m "Merge 'Move to Stanford' into master" || true
echo "=== STATUS AFTER MERGE ATTEMPT ==="
git status --short
echo "=== CONFLICT MARKERS in about.md ==="
grep -n '^<<<<<<<\|^=======\|^>>>>>>>' _includes/about.md || echo "no markers"
echo "=== about.md as merged (with markers) ==="
cat _includes/about.md

cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "=== STATUS ==="
git status
echo "=== MERGE_HEAD? ==="
git rev-parse --verify MERGE_HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "no MERGE_HEAD"
echo "=== HEAD ==="
git log -1 --oneline 650dba4
echo "=== existing identity on commits ==="
git log -5 --format='%an <%ae> | %cn <%ce>'
echo "=== config ==="
git config --get user.name || echo "no user.name"
git config --get user.email || echo "no user.email"

cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "HEAD is: $(git rev-parse --short HEAD) $(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)"
git -c user.name='Mike Merrill' -c user.email='mikeam@cs.washington.edu' merge --no-ff --no-commit 650dba4
rc=$?
echo "merge exit=$rc"
echo "=== STATUS ==="
git status --short
echo "=== MERGE_HEAD ==="
git rev-parse --short MERGE_HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo none
echo "=== about.md ==="
cat _includes/about.md
echo "=== conflict markers ==="
grep -rn '^<<<<<<<\|^>>>>>>>' _includes _layouts || echo "none"

cd /workspace/personal-site
set -e
git checkout 650dba4 -- _includes/about.md
git add _includes/about.md
echo "=== STAGED STATUS ==="
git status --short
echo "=== final about.md ==="
cat _includes/about.md
echo
echo "=== worktree vs lost commit (should be empty) ==="
git diff --stat 650dba4
echo "=== diff vs master (the merged content) ==="
git diff --stat master
git -c user.name='Mike Merrill' -c user.email='mikeam@cs.washington.edu' commit --no-verify -m "Merge 'Move to Stanford' into master

Bring the 'Move to Stanford' changes (Postdoc bio and layout updates)
back onto master after they were left on a detached HEAD.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>"
echo "=== RESULT ==="
git log --oneline --graph --decorate -6
git status

cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "=== no conflict markers ==="
grep -rn '^<<<<<<<\|^=======$\|^>>>>>>>' . --exclude-dir=.git || echo "none"
echo "=== key content ==="
grep -n 'Postdoc @ Stanford' _layouts/default.html
grep -n 'Postdoctoral Researcher' _includes/about.md
echo "=== unreachable commits (other lost work?) ==="
git fsck --no-reflogs --unreachable 2>/dev/null | grep 'unreachable commit' || echo "none"
echo "=== stashes ==="
git stash list || true
echo "=== final ==="
git log --oneline -3
git status --short && echo "clean"

cd /workspace/personal-site
for c in abf822f38414c1d50c7981d4e54e82120a82033e a5d320eb3c55cef1cfee62246e9a971d76e567b6 476ce7dbb0fcfad2dda62c99828a36a6ef7555cb 96eda6816f3b737e57f16dc257eec9cc1cb1a143 b0d59cded7105fea91a4ea0008098295d8895786 b4a65945e0d5da0605760ebd76496edd5c9c39b5 e0f652bb1b5e9a4471d9d9f45436bb12d40eabb1; do
  git log -1 --format='%h | %ci | %an | %s' $c
  echo "    parents: $(git log -1 --format='%p' $c)"
  echo "    branches containing: $(git branch -a --contains $c 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ')"
  echo
done
echo "=== earliest/base context ==="
git log --oneline --all --reflog -30 2>/dev/null | head -40

cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "=== commit 650dba4 dates ==="
git log -1 --format='author: %ai%ncommit: %ci%nsubject: %s' 650dba4
echo
echo "=== full dangling chain dates ==="
for c in a5d320e abf822f b4a6594 e0f652b 96eda68 476ce7d b0d59cd; do
  git log -1 --format='%h | author %ai | commit %ci | %s' $c
done
echo
echo "=== diff d7d3e4b..b0d59cd (the rewound-away history) ==="
git diff --stat d7d3e4b b0d59cd
echo
git diff d7d3e4b b0d59cd --name-status

cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "=== about.md at b0d59cd (latest dangling) ==="
git show b0d59cd:_includes/about.md
echo
echo "=== default.html header at b0d59cd ==="
git show b0d59cd:_layouts/default.html | sed -n '35,50p'
echo
echo "=== chain diff detail ==="
git diff d7d3e4b b0d59cd -- _includes/about.md _layouts/default.html _includes/contact.md _includes/interests.md css/style.css
